scope.summary: Implement the HBR-VIS enforcement path: every GUI/operator-surface/diagnostic-surface/frontend Studio change MUST be inspected and (where steered) verified through Argus with stable author_id targets, before/after observation, and recorded evidence per .GOV/roles_shared/docs/ARGUS_VISUAL_INSPECTION_PROTOCOL.md; missing Argus visibility/steering is HBR-VIS debt with allowed same-MT/WP remediation. Also proves steerability is command-API-first (STU-MDL-004): Argus drives AccessKit controls by author_id, never OS-level input injection.
acceptance_criteria: every GUI/diagnostic change Argus-inspected with evidence; command-API-first steering; HBR-VIS debt recorded
proof_targets: Argus before/after evidence + no-OS-injection steering test
expected_tests: argus: a GUI change is inspected with before/after + recorded evidence
negative: steering uses argus.click/set_value by author_id, never OS input injection
test: missing Argus target recorded as HBR-VIS debt

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Validation / Argus visual proof (model layer)

risk_if_missed: GUI changes ship without visual proof; steering falls to OS input injection.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
